name: Yuumi
notes: No ally exists in the fight, so Yuumi is never attached to an Anchor: You and Me! (W) has no valid target and is never cast, Prowling Projectile (Q) only ever deals its base unattached missile damage (it never reaches the channeled/accelerated tier and never grants the Best Friend on-hit bonus, both of which require an Anchor), and Zoomies (E) affects Yuumi herself instead of redirecting to an Anchor.
Feline Friendship (passive) only ever heals Yuumi (or a nearby Anchor) and never deals damage, so it is left out of the kit entirely.

The opening cast is Final Chapter (R) at t=0, since its long cooldown (100-120s at rank 1-3) means only one cast reliably fits in a short fight; its 5 waves are assumed to fire at 0, 0.75, 1.5, 2.25 and 3.0s (the sheet's 0.75s wave interval) and all to hit the single stationary dummy, with the wiki's 25% reduced damage applied to waves 2-5 as repeat hits on the same target.

During Final Chapter's channel, Prowling Projectile is disabled and basic attacks do not occur, per the ability's channel-interaction table (Zoomies remains usable); Prowling Projectile and attacks resume the instant the last wave lands.
Final Chapter's cooldown starts post-effect, at the moment the last wave lands, per the wiki's cdstart note.
Prowling Projectile (Q) is cast on cooldown (6.5s, no cast time) whenever it and the channel lock allow.
Zoomies (E) is cast on cooldown (10s) purely for its self attack-speed buff; its shield and bonus movement speed do not matter in a stationary damage-only fight.
Mana costs are not modeled: nothing here plausibly empties Yuumi's level-16 mana pool inside a 15 s fight.
Q is maxed first for its damage, then E for extra attack-speed uptime on Yuumi's basic attacks; W is maxed last since it is never cast.
